run_preprocess_input: run the script to convert SIMMC JSON dialog data into GPT-2 line-by-line stringified format
convert_json_to_flattened: convert JSON dialog data to flattened predict and target outputs with configurable context turns
run_with_multimodal: run preprocessing with multimodal contexts enabled for each dialog turn
run_with_special_tokens: run preprocessing with custom special tokens input and output paths
run_with_context_length: run preprocessing with a custom number of dialog turns included as context
